title: Minimum Initial Strength to Defeat All Monsters
summary: Given an integer array monsters, where each element represents the strength of a monster, and a 2D integer array boosts, where each element is a triplet [li, ri, vi] indicating that a temporary bonus of vi is available while fighting any monster whose index is between li and ri (inclusive), calculate the minimum initial strength required to defeat all the monsters.
statement: Given an integer array monsters, where each element represents the strength of a monster, and a 2D integer array boosts, where each element is a triplet [li, ri, vi] indicating that a temporary bonus of vi is available while fighting any monster whose index is between li and ri (inclusive), calculate the minimum initial strength required to defeat all the monsters. For each monster at index i: - Determine the total temporary bonus bonus by summing the values of all applicable boosts. - You can defeat the monster if your current strength plus bonus is at least the monster's strength. - After defeating the monster, your current strength decreases by the monster's strength. If your strength becomes negative, it is set to 0. Return the minimum initial strength needed to defeat all the monsters.
constraints: Fight monsters in index order; interval boosts temporarily add to strength only while checking their covered indices.
After victory, subtract monster strength and clamp permanent strength at zero.
Return the least initial permanent strength that defeats all monsters.
reference_solution:
def minimum_initial_monster_strength(monsters,boosts):
    delta=[0]*(len(monsters)+1)
    for left,right,value in boosts:delta[left]+=value;delta[right+1]-=value
    def wins(initial):
        bonus=0
        for need,change in zip(monsters,delta):
            bonus+=change
            if initial+bonus<need:return False
            initial=max(0,initial-need)
        return True
    low,high=0,sum(monsters)
    while low<high:
        middle=(low+high)//2
        if wins(middle):high=middle
        else:low=middle+1
    return low
